heroHeadline: Ruto Softens Foreign-Trader Crackdown After Week of Backlash as Kiprotich Abduction Probe Drags On
heroSubtitle: President Ruto and Prime CS Mudavadi rolled back the closure-first framing of the foreign-trader order on September 12 after embassy queues, an AU rights-body warning, and the dismissal of an AU adviser who criticized the policy, while IPOA and DCI have yet to publicly name any of the four officers linked to journalist Alex Kiprotich's September 1 abduction
